about.headline: I’m a software engineer focused on the part of software that actually makes a business run:
about.headlineAccent: data, workflows, APIs and reliable systems.
paragraphs: My experience is centered around backend development and business applications. I enjoy turning messy requirements into structured systems that teams can actually use.
I have worked across PHP, CodeIgniter, MySQL, JavaScript and APIs, while expanding toward modern backend engineering with Python and stronger system design.
I care about clean architecture, database design, performance and building software that remains understandable after the first release.

experience.description: Building and maintaining backend features, web systems and data-driven functionality with a focus on reliable application behavior.
